hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath' | { read -r f; bunx prettier --write "$f"; } 2>/dev/null || true

jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // ""' | { read -r f; case "$f" in */index.ts|*/commands/*.ts) echo "[ponto help] Command file changed — updated --help output:"; cd "$(dirname "$(dirname "$f")" 2>/dev/null || echo .)" && bun run index.ts --help 2>&1 ;; esac; } 2>/dev/null || true
